image_description: A black wrought-iron bannister installed on an outdoor brick staircase. The railing features a continuous top handrail, thick vertical newel posts at the ends and corners, and decorative scrolled infill panels between the posts instead of simple vertical balusters. The background consists of a red brick wall and a window.
